## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves unrelated behavior.
- [ ] Documentation and descriptions match the resulting behavior.
- [ ] For implementation changes, I built and installed the mod locally and ran relevant checks; otherwise this is documentation-only.
- [ ] I have distinguished managed checks from in-game and live co-op testing.
- [ ] No proprietary game dependencies, local secrets, or generated logs are included.
- [ ] My contribution is compatible with GPL-3.0-only.
